info.name: IncidentFlow
info.description:
End-to-end tests for incident-service (8080) and notification-service (8081).

**Before running**
1. `docker compose up -d` (Postgres, Redis, Kafka)
2. Start incident-service with `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='ChangeMe123!'` (same value as the `adminPassword` collection variable)
3. Start notification-service

**Run the whole collection in order** (Collection Runner, keep the order). Each folder depends on the variables the previous one stored. Every run uses fresh usernames and service names, so it can be repeated.

item.description:
Needs **notification-service** running on port 8081.

**Watch the live stream** (Postman cannot show an SSE stream well, so use curl):

```
curl -N localhost:8081/api/notifications/stream -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```

**Replay missed notifications:** add `-H "Last-Event-ID: 2"`.

**Test duplicates and poison messages by publishing to Kafka directly** (key and JSON separated by `:`):

```
docker exec -i incidentflow-kafka-1 /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-console-producer.sh \
  --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --topic incident-events \
  --property parse.key=true --property key.separator=:
```

Then type, for example:

```
9001:{"eventId":"11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","eventType":"INCIDENT_CREATED","incidentId":9001,"serviceName":"manual-test","title":"Manual","severity":"SEV3","status":"OPEN","occurredAt":"2026-10-04T10:00:00Z"}
9001:{"eventId":"11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","eventType":"INCIDENT_CREATED","incidentId":9001,"serviceName":"manual-test","title":"Manual","severity":"SEV3","status":"OPEN","occurredAt":"2026-10-04T10:00:00Z"}
9001:this is not json
```

Sending the same event twice must produce **one** notification. The last line must land in the dead-letter topic:

```
docker exec incidentflow-kafka-1 /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-console-consumer.sh \
  --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --topic incident-events.DLT --from-beginning
```
